emergency: Immediate danger, serious injury or overdose: call 999 or go to A&E. Do not wait for a café, peer call or email.
urgent: Urgent mental health help: call NHS 111 and select the mental health option, 24/7. Use the person’s crisis plan and usual team where available.
staff: For a safeguarding concern, follow the service’s safeguarding procedure and contact the named lead or backup. Record who accepted the handover. Peer callers share information and seek help; the receiving service decides assessment and referral needs.
ageNote: Local services have different age and access rules. For a child or young person, or if unsure which route fits, use NHS 111’s mental health option.
